cases.comparison: All four responses must preserve the question bytes and ID, include the expected address, and carry AD.
cases.oracle: Independent UDP peer sends mixed-case names and distinct IDs to the resolver while the BIND-controlled signed zone establishes the correct A record.
cases.purpose: Preserve exact original question case and transaction ID for fresh and cached validated answers with DO both off and on.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-denial-proof-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> srv.err & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 ok) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 4 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> resolver.err & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-question-case-peer.py 5320 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
